_readme: Copy this to private/gold.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
One key per file, named relative to the folder you scan (scan 'private/' -> 'syllabus.pdf').
List every deadline, exam and to-do a student would want on their calendar, with the REAL date from the file.
'text' only needs to be recognisable: 'HW 1' = 'Homework 1' = 'Assignment 1'; 'Midterm' = 'Midterm exam'.
Leave [] for a file that has no dates; the scorer then counts any item the extractor invents as an error.
A to-do with no date in the file goes in the file that contains it, dated the day before its exam (that is what the extractor does).
When a later file moves a date (announcement vs syllabus), list the new date under the later file only.
